commitments.detail: An independent convener will be appointed, no existing co-chair will solely chair meetings, and facilitated joint sessions will be held to address the unresolved conflict disclosed in the confidential ER intake.
A written charter will be provided to members, and a formal review will occur after exactly 90 days.
Meetings will start at 2:00 p.m. with recordings and asynchronous access provided.
Separate opt-in votes will be held in each existing group, requiring at least two-thirds approval from voting members in each group before the merged program launches.
